title: ERP Implementation — Tiraz
summary: Modeled business processes for a fictional company using Dolibarr ERP.
challenge: Understand how business functions share information in an integrated system.
approach: Explored HR, sales, procurement, manufacturing, and finance workflows for a B2B furniture business.
outcome: Demonstrated an academic ERP workflow across multiple business functions.
learned: Reliable data flow across departments supports better operational decisions.
